build_IndependentCNF: build an IndependentCNF model with configurable hidden dims, layer type, and time squashing options
run_logprob: run logprob on event times and spatial locations to compute masked log probabilities
run_spatial_conditional_logprob_fn: run spatial conditional log probability function to get a loglikelihood function at a given time t
run_gaussian_loglik: run gaussian_loglik to compute Gaussian log-likelihood given z, mean, and log standard deviation
review_IndependentCNF: review the IndependentCNF class and its CNF integration, logprob computation, and latent variable parameters
